resources.string: Each strip is a set with its load and reps. Tap it to change load, reps, RPE or set type, or to remove it.
The circle on the right logs the set as done; it turns green and the rest starts.
The rest bar shows the time left. +15 s extends it and Skip ends it. It rings even with the screen off.
What you did on this exercise in your previous session, so you know what to beat.
Swipe sideways to go to the previous or next exercise.
Reverts or repeats the last change to a set, also offline.
Opens the exercise list with progress: jump to one, reorder or add another.
Time since you started, at the bottom left.
Opens the summary to save the session with its effort and notes.
Tells which plates to load on each side of the bar to reach a weight.
Exercises and sets of the session, with the approximate time.
Optional: note your sleep and energy from 1 to 5 to see later how they affect your performance.
Creates the session and opens logging. You can close the app: the session waits for you.
Volume is load times reps added up, without warm-ups.
Exercises where you beat your estimated best.
Save closes the session; Save as template creates a routine from what you did; Discard deletes it.
Your finished sessions, newest first. Tap one to see it or repeat it.
What you planned for today. Start opens the session preview.
A session without a routine: add exercises while you train.
Shows when a session was missed: do it today, push the plan or skip it.
Routines are your workouts; Programs arrange them by week; Calendar shows what is planned each day.
Search by name, with or without accents.
Filter by available equipment, discipline, muscle, equipment and difficulty. Active filters appear next to it and are removed with a tap.
Each card shows the discipline and level. Tap it to see how it is done.
Adds your own exercise that is not in the library.
Your workout today, or the rest or active rest notice.
Your next planned workout and how many you did this week.
The person icon opens your profile: language, theme, English names and account.
